verdict.rationale: A domain registrar and DNS product could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows one. The XML API, Go SDK and Terraform provider are developer building blocks for automation, not an in-product assistant, and the live chat mentioned in the evidence is human support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
